detail.longDescription: RE: https:// mastodon.com.pl/@grono/1173619 91910931158 Digging a bit into CVE-2026-92543, this one looks bad. A MITM can trivially get # docker to ignore TLS certificate issues when pulling content from a registry, allowing an attacker with control of the network to inject malicious container images to run on the target. Digest pinning and signature verification would prevent this attack.
